[Unit]
Description=Antrieb static routed segments on eth1/eth2
After=sonic.target network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/antrieb-segments.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
cat > /usr/local/sbin/antrieb-segments.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
ip addr del 240.127.1.1/24 dev docker0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set docker0 down 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 172.20.1.1/24 dev eth1 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 172.20.2.1/24 dev eth2 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth1.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth2.forwarding=1
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/antrieb-segments.sh
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now antrieb-segments.service
systemctl status antrieb-segments.service --no-pager | head -10
